rule.development: 5 nominal runs only; no fault/trajectory-error based choice
rule.M1: max(1.0,1.25*quantile_0.995 of available max absolute prefit innovations / frozen range_sigma=.2 across 5 nominal dev runs)
rule.M2: max(.05m,1.25*quantile_0.995 of available max antenna XY full-minus-independent-exclusion distances across same dev runs)
rule.release: immediate on below threshold; consecutive counter resets on unavailable; no detector feedback to locator
rule.validity: accepted full graph, >=3 current anchors and current raw XY geometry rank2; M2 additionally all four hypotheses accepted with >=3 current retained anchors, rank2 range geometry and full-rank weighted objective Jacobian; any failed/rank-invalid hypothesis => unavailable, never trusted
